title: Choose fitr's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Repair Bench. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Repair Bench
options.lineage: american workwear mending benches, shipping tags, selvedge repair
options.thesis: The wardrobe as a workbench: garments are pieces laid on indigo canvas, wear is patina, gaps are repairs waiting.
options.viewport: Today's suggestion hangs as one big kraft work-ticket: outfit collage stamped on top, the stylist's reason set like a chalk note beneath, two riveted buttons — Wore it / Something else — at the foot.
options.risk: Deep indigo grounds must keep light garments legible — surface cards carry that job, and it is checked in both themes.

raised.raise: Navigation becomes a real structural rail — hue-coded current section, not floating text links.
All motion is damped and physical: numbers and needles ease with spring damping, nothing snaps.

options.label: The Pattern Table
options.lineage: atelier pattern-drafting tables, oak-tag manila, red pencil
options.thesis: Every garment is a drafted piece and an outfit is the assembly — a gap in an outfit is literally a missing pattern piece.
options.viewport: Today's outfit drawn as pattern pieces assembling on manila, red-pencil annotations naming each piece, grain-line arrow pointing at the weather.
options.risk: Flirts with the quiet cream-paper register the app already wears — boldest execution required to leave it behind.

options.label: Sneaker Archive Wall
options.lineage: stacked sneaker boxes, end-label colorway poetry
options.thesis: The closet as an archive wall: everything shelved, labelled, and pull-able — today's fit slides half out of its box.
options.viewport: A wall of labelled boxes; the daily pick sits half-pulled, lid hinged, tissue folded back.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on identity — sneaker culture is fit culture — but the box metaphor slows the scan-and-compose jobs.
options.risk: Reads sneakerhead-narrow for a whole-wardrobe app.

options.label: Park Poster
options.thesis: Each day printed as one flat-ink sheet: the forecast is the landscape, the outfit is the imperative beneath it.
options.viewport: Layered flat planes — sky reads the forecast, midground the occasion — over a caption-bar imperative: SEE TODAY.
options.case: Shares americana DNA with the bench and sings on Today, but flattens under intake and settings density.
options.risk: Poster scale collapses into wallpaper when every screen must carry it.

options.label: Tabbed Field Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals, punched acetate leaves
options.thesis: The app as a tabbed manual: every section a coloured divider board, content floating on acetate leaves above it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: software-manual register fights fashion identity — but its wayfinding discipline was adopted by the bench.
options.kept: The stepped tab rail: navigation you can feel the extent of.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every wardrobe app ships — clean neutral gallery, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
